## Pre-registered decision rule

ΔGini (M2 − M1) on OOT = 3.17 points, 95% CI [2.90, 3.46]. Rule: M2 champion iff ΔGini ≥ 2.0 and CI lower bound > 0. → **Champion = M2_lgbm**

## Reason-code agreement (applicants declined by both models)

n = 40,133; M1 top-1 == M2 top-1: 47.6%; M1 top-1 within M2 top-4: 89.4%. Low agreement is expected partly because M2 can use correlated substitutes (e.g. avg_cur_bal vs tot_hi_cred_lim).
